ruleDefinitions.name: Macos Remote System Discovery
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the enumeration of other remote systems.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\/arp$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-a.*")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\/ping$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ 10\\\..*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ 192\\\.168\\\..*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ 172\\\.16\\\..*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ 172\\\.17\\\..*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ 172\\\.18\\\..*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ 172\\\.19\\\..*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ 172\\\.20\\\..*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ 172\\\.21\\\..*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ 172\\\.22\\\..*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ 172\\\.23\\\..*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ 172\\\.24\\\..*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ 172\\\.25\\\..*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ 172\\\.26\\\..*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ 172\\\.27\\\..*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ 172\\\.28\\\..*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ 172\\\.29\\\..*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ 172\\\.30\\\..*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ 172\\\.31\\\..*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ 127\\\..*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ 169\\\.254\\\..*"))))
